Usage: tally <dir>

Reports every *.csv file directly under <dir>: its name, how many data rows it
holds (the first line is the header, and is not counted), and how many columns
its header declares. Files that cannot be read as CSV are reported as failures
and do not stop the run.

Exits 0 if every file was counted, 1 if any file failed,
2 if the directory co
